//: Build profiles. See docs/testflight.md for what to run and in what order.

//development: A dev client for working on native code. Needed because expo-image-picker
does not run in Expo Go — the moment a native module is added, `expo start`
against Expo Go stops being a faithful preview.
Install on a registered device: eas build -p ios --profile development
//simulator: Same as development but for the iOS Simulator, which needs no paid
account and no registered device. The fastest way to see the app running
//preview: A release build, signed ad-hoc, installed by link on devices registered
with `eas device:create`. Use for a handful of people before TestFlight,
or when a tester cannot wait for Apple's processing.
//production: The TestFlight and App Store build. autoIncrement bumps the iOS build
number on EAS rather than in the repo, which is why appVersionSource is
remote above — two people building on the same day cannot then collide.

//: ascAppId is the numeric Apple ID of the app record, NOT the bundle id.
None of these three are secrets — the team id ships inside every build
and the app id is in the app's own App Store URL. The actual credential
is the App Store Connect API key (.p8), which eas prompts for and stores
against the Expo project. It never belongs in this file or this repo.
appleId is optional: leave it out and eas asks, or set EXPO_APPLE_ID.
It is here because it saves a prompt on every submit.
